So I'm closing this one and I will open another one that revert back the behavior of the URL sync.

> That should do it if there's not so much people impacted by the current bug.

The original bug that I was trying to fix (#2105) makes the UI inconsistent with the actual search results. The current fix also led to other issues because of its impact in the URL sync. Since we are aware of the behavior that felt like a bug, and it actually isn't because we introduced it on purpose.
